Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq leads Wall Street gains as chip, AI stocks rebound
Markets.summary: US stocks finished mixed on Monday as the Nasdaq rose due to a rebound in chip and AI-related stocks. Investors monitored corporate earnings and fresh stock moves while ongoing worries about AI spending persisted.

Markets.title: Hedge funds retreat from tech at fastest pace in a decade as AI trade weakens
Markets.summary: Hedge funds reduced their technology stock exposure at the fastest rate in at least a decade amid a weakening artificial intelligence trade. According to Goldman Sachs data, the sell-off drove a sharp reduction in risk, though technology still constitutes a major part of fund portfolios.

Markets.title: S&P Global flags potentially hidden AI debt at hyperscalers as AI spending surges
Markets.summary: S&P Global warned that major tech companies may be hiding AI-related debt through complex data center and startup financing structures. While the credit agency sees no immediate need for rating changes, it flagged escalating investments and profitability as key risks.

Markets.title: Jio IPO: LIC, BlackRock, Fidelity, GIC among 212 anchor investors to pour Rs 8,110 crore
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms raised about Rs 8,110 crore from 212 anchor investors, including LIC, BlackRock, and Fidelity, ahead of its upcoming IPO. This strong participation from domestic and global institutions sets the stage for an IPO expected to surpass Hyundai Motor India's previous record.

Markets.title: AI stocks rebound as CoreWeave jumps on Goldman Sachs upgrade
Markets.summary: AI stocks rebounded from last week's selloff, led by gains in semiconductor companies and a Goldman Sachs upgrade for CoreWeave. Investors are now awaiting upcoming tech earnings reports for insights into AI spending and valuations.

Markets.title: Ireda net profit grows to Rs 554 cr in Sep qtr
Markets.summary: Ireda reported a net profit of Rs 554 crore for the September quarter of FY27, driven by a 14% increase in operating revenue to Rs 2,345 crore. The renewable energy financier also saw loan disbursements surge by 31% to Rs 10,579 crore.

Geo-Political.title: Curfew imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after rioting across France
Geo-Political.summary: Curfews have been imposed in parts of central Paris and other French cities following widespread rioting. This action was taken after the country's interior minister admitted that police had lost control in certain areas.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: A Ukrainian presidential adviser told the BBC that US restrictions on intelligence sharing are causing Ukrainian deaths by delaying warnings of incoming missile attacks. The White House stated that there have been no changes to its intelligence-sharing policies with Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
Geo-Political.summary: Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie was convicted of 191 murder charges, nearly all of which were children. He had instructed parents to starve their children to death.

Geo-Political.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support, says court filing
Geo-Political.summary: A court filing alleges that a former OpenAI worker accused of planting a tracking device received support from the Saudi government. The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

Geo-Political.title: Tennis star Svitolina says emotional toll of Ukraine war led to Monfils separation
Geo-Political.summary: Professional tennis players Elina Svitolina and Gael Monfils are separating after marrying in 2021 and having one child together. Svitolina stated that the emotional toll of the ongoing war in Ukraine contributed to the split.

Geo-Political.title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded
Geo-Political.summary: Former Rwandan army sergeant major and YouTuber Robert Kabera was found beheaded in Uganda, where he had sought asylum after becoming an exiled critic of the Rwandan president. Ugandan authorities are currently investigating the killing of the popular singer and political critic.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand trade pact takes effect on October 20: How it benefits both sides | Key highlights
Data & Insights.summary: India and New Zealand's free trade agreement takes effect on October 20, granting Indian exports full duty-free access. The pact aims to increase bilateral trade to about ₹35,000 crore by 2030.

Data & Insights.title: Amitabh Kant on how India’s semiconductor future is taking shape: 6 states with 12 projects,  ₹1.64 lakh cr investments
Data & Insights.summary: India has attracted 1.64 lakh crore rupees in investments for 12 semiconductor projects across six states. Gujarat leads this initiative with six approved projects, highlighted by a major 91,526 crore rupee fabrication plant from Tata-PSMC.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: No tariff on Indian exports from Oct 20; Textile, pharma, leather exports to gain market access
Data & Insights.summary: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement takes effect on October 20, eliminating tariffs on all Indian exports. This agreement will boost sectors like textiles, leather, and pharmaceuticals while strengthening bilateral trade ties.

Data & Insights.title: Is India’s solar power play facing its Icarus moment?
Data & Insights.summary: India's rapid growth in solar power is overwhelming its electricity grid due to infrastructure bottlenecks. The government must upgrade this transmission infrastructure to prevent these bottlenecks from derailing the country's clean energy goals.

Data & Insights.title: FM Sitharaman flags global capital moving towards US, AI-linked markets as a ‘concern’ for India in 2027
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman warned that global capital shifting toward the US and artificial intelligence markets poses a major risk of investment outflows for India by 2027. She highlighted this trend as a significant concern for the country's financial stability and economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Govt plans  ₹25,000-crore skilling push to sharpen textile export edge
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has announced a ₹25,000-crore initiative called Samarth 2.0 in the 2026–27 budget to boost textile exports. The program will modernize workforce training through industry and academic collaboration to meet advancing technological demands.

India.title: Bomb Hoax On IndiGo Flight In Chennai, Fliers Deboarded, Take-Off Delayed
India.summary: An IndiGo flight at the Chennai airport was delayed after receiving a bomb threat. All passengers were safely offloaded while security personnel conducted mandatory anti-sabotage checks.

India.title: Inspired By Reels, 3 Friends Came Up With 'Bigshot' Plan. Why It Failed
India.summary: Inspired by an Instagram reel, a minor convinced two friends to join him in a criminal plan to become a bigshot. The scheme ultimately failed, leading to their apprehension.

India.title: Tiger Shroff Firing Case Updates: 3 Suspects Undergo Medical Examination In Kota, Transit Remand Granted
India.summary: Three suspects in the Tiger Shroff firing case underwent a medical examination in Kota after being granted transit remand. Tiger Shroff sustained injuries to his shoulder, chest, and right arm during the incident.

India.title: Marco Rubio To Begin 3-Day India Tour Today, Will Honour 26/11 Victims
India.summary: Marco Rubio is beginning a three-day tour of India today. During his time in Mumbai, he will meet with S Jaishankar and lay a wreath at the Taj memorial to honor the victims of the 26/11 terror attacks.

India.title: UP Murder Convict Wishes To Contest Polls. High Court Pauses His Conviction
India.summary: The Allahabad High Court has temporarily paused the 2025 murder conviction of Nandlal Rai alias Babloo Rai from a 2017 case. This court order allows the Varanasi convict to contest upcoming elections while his criminal appeal is pending.

India.title: Dussehra 2026: Dry Day Restrictions, Bank Closures And What's Open Or Closed
India.summary: Dussehra 2026 brings specific commercial and public service restrictions across India. The guidelines detail operational closures and openings for liquor shops and banks during the festival.

General.summary: Cleanup efforts have begun following severe riots in France. Marseille suffered some of the worst damage, where shop owners reported that over 600 businesses were looted while police maintained their presence.

General.summary: Andy Burnham has pledged to end unfair parking penalties for drivers using private land under new regulations. The proposed rules aim to address current charges that are widely considered too harsh on motorists.

General.title: Woman says she 'closed eyes and tried not to be there' during alleged Russell Brand rape
General.summary: A 51-year-old woman testified that she closed her eyes and tried to dissociate during an alleged rape by Russell Brand. Brand faces a total of seven charges, including three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault, and one count of indecent assault.

General.title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
General.summary: A spacecraft is launching on a mission to collect 10 grams of dust from a Martian moon. The probe will then return the sample back to Earth.
